# Kislap

> Kislap is an open-source customizable personal page builder for combining links, work, socials, projects, promos, and other important content into one public page.

## What Kislap does

Kislap lets a person create one public Page, arrange it with structured content blocks, choose a layout and theme, and publish it on a hosted Kislap URL such as `yourname.kislap.app`.

Kislap is useful as a link-in-bio page, personal website, creator hub, developer page, freelancer profile, or lightweight portfolio-style page. These are use cases of the same Kislap Page product, not separate products.

## Main capabilities

- Profile and personal introduction
- Link blocks
- Social links
- Text and About blocks
- Featured projects
- Experience and skills
- Promo cards
- Banners and quotes
- Support and QR cards
- Reorderable content blocks
- Full, two-thirds, half, and one-third block widths
- Multiple page layouts
- Custom themes, typography, spacing, radius, and shadows
- Responsive public pages
- Hosted Kislap subdomain
- Open-source codebase

## Who Kislap is for

- Creators
- Developers
- Freelancers and virtual assistants
- Students
- Makers
- People who need one shareable page for their online presence

## Important URLs

- Website: https://kislap.app/
- Builder: https://builder.kislap.app/
- Showcase: https://kislap.app/showcase
- About: https://kislap.app/about
- Help: https://kislap.app/help
- Open source: https://kislap.app/source
- Example Page: https://juandelacruz.kislap.app/

## Product terminology

Use "Kislap Page" for the current product. "Link-in-bio page", "personal page", and "Linktree alternative" may be used descriptively for discovery, but Kislap is designed to support richer blocks than a basic list of links.

Kislap previously exposed separate Portfolio and Menu creation paths. Those are legacy product concepts and should not be described as the current Kislap product offering.
